notes: Medium band (total 15). Six linked deliverables push dependent_stages (2): a broken-proxy egress fetch, a Spark standalone cluster (master+worker launched by hand, then local[*] and spark:// submits), a chained three-stage pipeline, and a 60s monitor. Debugging_ambiguity (2) is the proxy-override diagnosis plus the missing-helper/missing-dir pipeline faults; reasoning_depth (2) spans choosing the correct config/split from a manifest, wiring a live JSON RPC, and neutralising the egress fault. Quantitative_correctness (2) needs a byte-for-byte fetch match, exact reserved-split totals, accurate status/block/tx/account fields, machine-readable runtimes, and a monitor that spans ~60s at ~10s intervals. hidden_case_generalization (2) re-runs load-dataset.py on an alternate hub repo (with non-numeric/blank cells, matching the documented skip rules) and chain-query.py against a second dev-mode node. Each rubric floor among the claimed competencies is <= medium, so no documented_probe is required.
